title: statusline r1 SA: segment format stability unstated
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 1. Lens: solution-architect (validator: solution-owner). Owner: SO session. Defect: segment is wired into adopter settings as a persistently-invoked command; only width budgets are versioned data — field set, order, separators, markers have no stability statement. Citations verified: contract:197, :268. Anchors: Status, renderer, vocabulary. Proposed: dismissed-candidate (machine consumers are directed to the machine form; segment is display rendering, not API) with retained note: state once that the segment is an unstable display rendering to foreclose adopters scripting against it. Failure if unfixed: low — adopter coupling to unversioned display format.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Dismissed at operator triage (round 1). Segment is a display rendering, not a machine surface; machine consumers are directed to the machine form. The retained note landed anyway via the fix pass: Status bullet now states the segment is an unstable display rendering and scripting against it belongs on the machine form — foreclosing adopter coupling without granting format stability.
